literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on xinchou day dispatched Xiao Delidi, who administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs, and [4] Niu Wenshu, who administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs, as envoys to Song to admonish return of invaded Xia territory.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, on xinchou day of the first spring month Xiao Delidi, who administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs, and [4] Niu Wenshu, who administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs, were sent as envoys to Song to admonish return of invaded Xia territory.

literal: Summer, fifth month, took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the court took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.

literal: Sixth month, on xinsi day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and others to give thanks.
idiomatic: On xinsi day of the sixth month Xia State sent Li Zaofu and others to give thanks.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guisi day Zubu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On guisi day of the seventh autumn month Zubu came with tribute.

literal: On jiawu day went to Black Ridge.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the court went to Black Ridge.

literal: On gengzi day hunted at Deer-Horn Mountain.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the court hunted at Deer-Horn Mountain.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on yihai day Song and Xia opened relations; Liu Zhengfu and Cao Mu were dispatched to announce it.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the tenth winter month Song and Xia opened relations; Liu Zhengfu and Cao Mu were sent to announce it.

literal: [5] On gengchen day Imperial Grand Uncle and Nanjing intendant Heluwo was also made tiyin; Eastern Capital intendant and Prince of Yue Chun was made Southern Court chancellor.
idiomatic: [5] On gengchen day Imperial Grand Uncle and Nanjing intendant Heluwo was also made tiyin; Eastern Capital intendant and Prince of Yue Chun was made Southern Court chancellor.

literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei day Xiejianu was made Southern Court great king; Manu was made great king of Xi Six Divisions.
idiomatic: On yiwei day of the eleventh month Xiejianu was made Southern Court great king; Manu was made great king of Xi Six Divisions.

literal: On bingshen day the firewood-bundle rite was performed.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the firewood-bundle rite was performed.

literal: On wuxu day general amnesty.
idiomatic: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely; [6] Prince of Yue Chun was advanced to Prince of Wei; imperial son Aoluwo was enfeoffed Prince of Jin; Xini Lie was enfeoffed Prince of Raole Commandery.
idiomatic: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely; [6] Prince of Yue Chun was advanced to Prince of Wei; imperial son Aoluwo was enfeoffed Prince of Jin; Xini Lie was enfeoffed Prince of Raole Commandery.

literal: On jihai day paid respects at Taizu's temple.
idiomatic: On jihai day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple.

literal: On jiachen day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.
idiomatic: On jiachen day sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.

literal: Twelfth month, on jisi day Yelü Yan was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery; remaining offices and titles were promoted in differing degrees.
idiomatic: On jisi day of the twelfth month Yelü Yan was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery; remaining offices and titles were promoted in differing degrees.

literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, angled for fish at Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the seventh year, in the first spring month the court angled for fish at Huntong River.

literal: Second month, halted at Great Fish Marsh.
idiomatic: In the second month the court halted at Great Fish Marsh.

literal: Summer, sixth month, stopped at Sanshui Plain.
idiomatic: In the sixth summer month the court stopped at Sanshui Plain.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, went to Black Ridge.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court went to Black Ridge.

literal: Winter, tenth month, paid respects at Qian Mausoleum and hunted at Mount Yiwulü.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum and hunted at Mount Yiwulü.

literal: That year advanced scholars Li Shi and one hundred others were released.
idiomatic: That year advanced scholars Li Shi and one hundred others were released.

literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, went to Chun Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the eighth year, in the first spring month the court went to Chun Prefecture.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingshen day the Goryeo king was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States and his father was posthumously enfeoffed King of Goryeo [7].
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the fourth summer month the Goryeo king was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States and his father was posthumously enfeoffed King of Goryeo [7].

literal: Fifth month, took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.
idiomatic: In the fifth month the court took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.

literal: Sixth month, on renchen day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Dili led the various tribes to court.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the sixth month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Dili led the various tribes to court.

literal: On bingshen day shot willow to pray for rain.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the court shot willow to pray for rain.

literal: On renyin day Xia King Li Qianshun, because Princess Cheng'an had borne a son, dispatched envoys to announce it.
idiomatic: On renyin day Xia King Li Qianshun, because Princess Cheng'an had borne a son, sent envoys to announce it.

literal: On dingwei day went to Black Ridge.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the court went to Black Ridge.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day, because of rain the hunt was abandoned.
idiomatic: On wuchen day of the seventh autumn month, because of rain, the hunt was abandoned.

literal: Winter, twelfth month, on jimao day Goryeo dispatched envoys to give thanks.
idiomatic: On jimao day of the twelfth winter month Goryeo sent envoys to give thanks.

literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on bingwu new moon, went to Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the ninth year, on the bingwu new moon of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.

literal: Second month, went to Chun Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Chun Prefecture.

literal: Third month, on wuwu day, because Song did not return territory, Xia dispatched envoys to report it.
idiomatic: On wuwu day of the third month, because Song did not return territory, Xia sent envoys to report it.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on renwu day the Five States Division came with tribute.
idiomatic: On renwu day of the fourth summer month the Five States Division came with tribute.

literal: Sixth month, on yihai day took summer ease at Teli Ridge.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the sixth month the court took summer ease at Teli Ridge.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, frost fell and damaged the crops.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month frost fell and damaged the crops.

literal: On jiayin day hunted at Houliji.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the court hunted at Houliji.

literal: Eighth month, on dingyou day snow fell and the hunt was abandoned.
idiomatic: On dingyou day of the eighth month snow fell and the hunt was abandoned.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on guiyou day gazed in sacrifice at Muye Mountain.
idiomatic: On guiyou day of the tenth winter month the court gazed in sacrifice at Muye Mountain.

literal: On dingchou day an edict remitted this year's rent and tax.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict remitted this year's rent and tax.

literal: Twelfth month, on jiashen day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiashen day of the twelfth month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That year advanced scholars Liu Zhen and ninety others were released.
idiomatic: That year advanced scholars Liu Zhen and ninety others were released.

literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on xinchou day the early spring rite was performed in advance.
idiomatic: In the tenth year, on xinchou day of the first spring month the early spring rite was performed in advance.

literal: Went to Huntong River.
idiomatic: The court went to Huntong River.

literal: Second month, on gengwu new moon, halted at Great Fish Marsh.
idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the second month the court halted at Great Fish Marsh.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingzi day chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the fourth summer month chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.

literal: On bingxu day the rebirth rite was performed in advance.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the rebirth rite was performed in advance.

literal: On guisi day hunted at Northern Mountain.
idiomatic: On guisi day the court hunted at Northern Mountain.

literal: Sixth month, on jiaxu day took summer ease at Jade Mound.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the sixth month the court took summer ease at Jade Mound.

literal: On guiwei day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and others with tribute.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Xia State sent Li Zaofu and others with tribute.

literal: On jiawu day Zubu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Zubu came with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinchou day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the seventh autumn month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Ninth month, on jiaxu day the Double Ninth Festival rite was waived.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the ninth month the Double Ninth Festival rite was waived.

literal: Winter, tenth month, halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: Twelfth month, on jiyou day the coming year's era name was changed.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the twelfth month the coming year's era name was changed.

literal: That year there was great famine.
idiomatic: That year there was great famine.

literal: In the first year of Tianqing, spring, first month, angled for fish at Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqing, in the first spring month the court angled for fish at Huntong River.

literal: Second month, went to Chun Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Chun Prefecture.

literal: Third month, on yihai day chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the third month chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.

literal: Summer, fifth month, took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the court took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, hunted.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted.

literal: Winter, tenth month, halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on jiwei new moon, went to Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the second year, on the jiwei new moon of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.

literal: On dingchou day chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingchou day chiefs of the Five States Division came with tribute.

literal: Second month, on dingyou day went to Chun Prefecture and went to Huntong River to angle for fish; [8] Raw Jurchen chiefs within a thousand li by precedent all came to court.
idiomatic: On dingyou day of the second month the court went to Chun Prefecture and went to Huntong River to angle for fish; [8] Raw Jurchen chiefs within a thousand li by precedent all came to court.

literal: It happened to be the "Head-Fish Banquet"; when the wine was half gone the emperor came to the hall front and ordered the chiefs in turn to dance;
idiomatic: It happened to be the Head-Fish Banquet; when the wine was half gone the emperor came to the hall front and ordered the chiefs in turn to dance;

literal: Aguda alone declined, saying he could not.
idiomatic: Aguda alone declined, saying he could not.

literal: He was admonished again and again but in the end would not comply.
idiomatic: He was admonished again and again but in the end would not comply.

literal: Another day the emperor secretly told Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian: "At the banquet the other day Aguda's spirit was bold and heroic and his glances were unusual; he could be entrusted with a border affair and executed.
idiomatic: Another day the emperor secretly told Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian, "At the banquet the other day Aguda's spirit was bold and heroic and his glances were unusual; he could be entrusted with a border affair and executed.

literal: Otherwise he will surely leave trouble for later."
idiomatic: Otherwise he will surely leave trouble for later."

literal: Fengxian said: "These wild people do not know ritual propriety; to kill them without great offense would surely wound hearts inclined toward transformation.
idiomatic: Fengxian said, "These wild people do not know ritual propriety; to kill them without great offense would surely wound hearts inclined toward transformation.

literal: Even if they had other intentions, what could they do?"
idiomatic: Even if they had other intentions, what could they do?"

literal: His younger brothers Wukimai, Nianhan, Hushe, and others had once followed the hunt; [9] they could call deer, stab tigers, and wrestle bears.
idiomatic: His younger brothers Wukimai, Nianhan, Hushe, and others had once followed the hunt; [9] they could call deer, stab tigers, and wrestle bears.

literal: The emperor was pleased and repeatedly added office and titles.
idiomatic: The emperor was pleased and repeatedly added office and titles.

literal: Summer, sixth month, on gengyin day took summer ease at Southern Cliff.
idiomatic: On gengyin day of the sixth summer month the court took summer ease at Southern Cliff.

literal: On jiawu day Uighurs of Hezhou came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Uighurs of Hezhou came with tribute.

literal: On wuxu day Princess Cheng'an came to court.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Princess Cheng'an came to court.

literal: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yichou day hunted at Southern Mountain.
idiomatic: On yichou day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Southern Mountain.

literal: Ninth month, on jiwei day shot and obtained a bear, feasted the hundred officials, and the emperor personally played the pipa.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the ninth month the court shot and obtained a bear, feasted the hundred officials, and the emperor personally played the pipa.

literal: Initially, when Aguda returned from the Huntong River banquet he suspected the emperor knew his other intent and thereupon raised troops, first annexing nearby divisions.
idiomatic: Initially, when Aguda returned from the Huntong River banquet he suspected the emperor knew his other intent and thereupon raised troops, first annexing nearby divisions.

literal: Jurchen Zhao San and Ahechan resisted; Aguda captured their families.
idiomatic: Jurchen Zhao San and Ahechan resisted; Aguda captured their families.

literal: The two men fled to complain at Xian Prefecture; the detailed-stable office sent them to the Northern Privy Council.
idiomatic: The two men fled to complain at Xian Prefecture; the detailed-stable office sent them to the Northern Privy Council.

literal: Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian reported it as an ordinary matter to the emperor and still sent them back to Xian Prefecture to be questioned and rebuked, intending that they reform themselves.
idiomatic: Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian reported it as an ordinary matter to the emperor and still sent them back to Xian Prefecture to be questioned and rebuked, intending that they reform themselves.

literal: After several summonses Aguda in the end claimed illness and did not come.
idiomatic: After several summonses Aguda in the end claimed illness and did not come.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinhai day the mother of Goryeo Duke of Three Han States Wang died; envoys came to announce it; envoys were immediately dispatched to offer sacrifice and grant mourning leave.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the tenth winter month the mother of Goryeo Duke of Three Han States Wang died; envoys came to announce it; envoys were immediately sent to offer sacrifice and grant mourning leave.

literal: That month halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.
idiomatic: That month the court halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.

literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day went to Nanjing.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the eleventh month the court went to Nanjing.

literal: On dingmao day paid respects at Taizu's temple.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple.

literal: That year advanced scholars Han and seventy-seven others were released.
idiomatic: That year advanced scholars Han and seventy-seven others were released.

literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on bingyin day money was bestowed on poor people of Nanjing.
idiomatic: In the third year, on bingyin day of the first spring month money was bestowed on poor people of Nanjing.

literal: On dingmao day went to Great Fish Marsh.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the court went to Great Fish Marsh.

literal: On jiaxu day monks and nuns were forbidden to break precepts.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day monks and nuns were forbidden to break precepts.

literal: On bingzi day hunted at Dog Tooth Mountain; great cold; many hunters died.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the court hunted at Dog Tooth Mountain; there was great cold and many hunters died.

literal: Third month, households of all circuits were registered; residents of the Dalao Hunting Ground were moved to other lands.
idiomatic: In the third month households of all circuits were registered; residents of the Dalao Hunting Ground were moved to other lands.

literal: One day Aguda led five hundred horsemen in a sudden dash to Xian Prefecture; officials and people were greatly alarmed.
idiomatic: One day Aguda led five hundred horsemen in a sudden dash to Xian Prefecture; officials and people were greatly alarmed.

literal: The next day he went to the detailed-stable office and faced Zhao San and the others in debate beneath the hall.
idiomatic: The next day he went to the detailed-stable office and faced Zhao San and the others in debate beneath the hall.

literal: Aguda would not yield and was sent to the relevant office for questioning.
idiomatic: Aguda would not yield and was sent to the relevant office for questioning.

literal: In one night he fled.
idiomatic: In one night he fled.
